blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
blocks.zh: 录像制作方面最近的进展要求以明确的法医证据为基础进行可靠的探测。 然而,目前的方法主要取决于忽略简短或局部文物的单一思维链推理,或预先界定的多代理工作流程,这些流程在选择相关检查时提供有限的灵活性。 即使进行了适应性调查,单靠优化调查政策并不能直接提高固定专家的法证能力. 我们介绍WeVisForensics,一个代理框架,在这个框架里,一个主要调查员协调一个自演的法医检查员子代理人图书馆,这些代理人跨越视觉和音频提示。 调查员了解需要检查的文物类型、哪个窗口和何时结束,这些互动为两个级别的代理人提供共享反馈。 我们的双时级政策优化战略,即DTPO,通过快速加强调查员的学习和在附加说明的文物间隔的指导下对视察员的更慢的改进,以报告他们曾经丢弃的微妙文物,从而关闭了这一循环。 此外,我们管理ForenCue-30K,将特定作用的法证说明和互动轨迹结合起来,以监督个别检查及其协调,并配有一个辅助学习库。 实验显示,WeVisForensics的平均检测精度为95.2%,跨越域内,域外和代理基准,比最强的先行探测器高9.0%,同时将判断结果建立在局部证据上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rapid advances in video generation have improved the visual fidelity, temporal coherence, and realism of synthetic content, bringing new possibilities to media creation. The same progress makes fabricated recordings increasingly difficult to distinguish from authentic ones, raising concerns over misinformation, impersonation, and public trust. Reliable AI-generated video detection is therefore becoming an essential component of media forensics, where decisive cues span visual, textual, and audio dimensions and call for role-specific inspection (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 视频制作的迅速进步,提高了视觉的忠实性,时间的一致性,以及合成内容的现实主义,为媒体创作带来了新的可能性. 同样的进步使得伪造的录音越来越难以与真实的录音区分开来,引起人们对错误信息、冒充和公众信任的关切。 因此,可靠的人工智能生成的视频探测正在成为媒体法证的一个基本组成部分,其中决定性的提示跨越视觉、文字和音频维度,并要求进行针对具体角色的检查(图1)。

blocks.en: To meet this need, recent studies [ 44 , 45 , 28 , 20 , 36 , 15 , 34 , 23 , 18 , 33 , 56 , 30 , 46 ] use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) either to reason about authenticity in natural language or to coordinate expert analysis. However, as illustrated in Figure 12 , these approaches still face two challenges in how forensic evidence is examined and used. a) Holistic single-pass reasoning. CoT-centric methods [ 36 , 20 , 28 , 44 , 45 ] judge the whole video in one pass, with one model covering every artifact type. Artifacts confined to a brief interval or a small region are easily missed or explained away by hallucinated rationales (Figure 6 a), and claims entangled in one free-form trace cannot be checked or supervised individually. b) Static workflows or coordinator-only learning. Agent-based detectors either run a fixed expert pipeline [ 46 , 30 , 17 ] or train only the coordinator over fixed specialists. ARGUS [ 56 ] collects four expert reports and freezes the observers while training the judge, so irrelevant reports can outweigh the one that finds the artifact (Figure 6 b). Tool-augmented detectors [ 33 , 47 ] instead learn when to invoke tools, yet keep tool backends fixed. Both remain bounded by the local accuracy of frozen sub-agents, since an inspector that misses a subtle cue limits what better routing or aggregation can recover (Figure 6 , right).
blocks.zh: 为了满足这一需要,最近的研究[44、45、28、20、36、15、34、23、18、33、56、30、46]使用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)来说明自然语言的真实性或协调专家分析。 然而,如图12所示,这些方法在法医证据的审查和使用方面仍然面临两个挑战。 (a) 国家 整体单行道推理. 以共T为中心的方法[36,20,28,44,45]用一个传记来判断整个视频,每个文物类型都有一个模型. 限于短暂间隔或小区域的人工活性很容易被幻觉推理所错过或解释(图6a),缠绕在一个自由形式追踪中的索赔无法单独检查或监督。 (b) 静态工作流程或只协调员学习。 基于代理人的探测器或运行固定专家管道[46、30、17],或仅对协调员进行固定专家的培训。 ARGUS[56]收集了4份专家报告,并在培训法官时冻结观察员,因此无关的报告可以超过找到文物的报告(图6b)。 工具辅助探测器[33,47]转而学习何时引用工具,但保持工具后端固定. 两者都以冻结子剂的当地准确性为界限,因为漏掉一个微妙提示的检查员会限制哪些更好的途径或聚合可以恢复(图6,右)。

blocks.en: To overcome these challenges, we introduce WeVisForensics (Figure 2 ), an agentic paradigm that couples adaptive evidence collection with a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents coordinated by a main investigator agent along two complementary designs. 1) Adaptive forensic analysis. The Forensic Sub-agent Library (FSL) holds trainable inspectors that examine visual appearance, physical consistency, commonsense plausibility, and on-screen text, while audio tools inspect the soundtrack when one is present. Each call specifies a forensic role and a temporal scope, and the selected inspector returns findings that inform subsequent reasoning. The investigator uses these observations to request further inspections or issue an authenticity verdict, so evidence collection adapts to each video beyond a predefined workflow. 2) Investigator-inspector self-evolution. Adaptive dispatch still relies on what each inspector can detect, so the inspectors must also improve from the calls they serve. Yet because the investigator decides which inputs the inspectors encounter while their responses shape its decisions, updating both on every batch makes each a moving target for the other. Our DTPO ( D ual- T imescale P olicy O ptimization) therefore trains both from shared trajectories on two timescales (Figure 3 ). The investigator’s inspection policy is updated on every rollout batch using outcome rewards and call-level feedback. The inspectors accumulate the calls issued by the investigator, keep those grounded in annotated artifact intervals, select responses with interaction feedback for privileged distillation, revise their skill cards of reporting rules, and periodically refresh the FSL. The refined inspectors then return to subsequent rollouts, so the agent evolves from its own environment.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些挑战,我们引入了WeVisForensics(图2)这一代理模式,即通过由主要调查人员协调的法医检查员子代理人自行开发的图书馆,将适应性证据收集在一起,并同时进行两个互补设计。 1) 适应性的法医分析。 法医分代理图书馆设有训练有素的检查员,负责检查视觉外观、身体一致性、常识可信度和屏幕文本,而音频工具则在有音轨时检查音轨。 每一次通话都规定了法医作用和时间范围,选定的检查员将报告结论作为随后推理的依据。 调查员利用这些观察来要求进一步检查或发布真实性判断,因此证据收集在预先确定的工作流程之外适应每个视频. 2)调查员-检查员自演. 适应性的调度仍然取决于每个检查员能够发现什么,因此检查员还必须从他们所服务的电话中改进。 然而,由于调查员决定检查员在答复中遇到哪些意见,从而决定了他们的决定,因此,每批资料都更新,使每批资料都成为相互移动的目标。 因此,我们的DTPO(D aual-T imemescale P policy O primization)在两个时标(图3)上从共享的轨迹进行训练。 调查员的检查政策在每批推出时都利用结果奖励和呼叫一级的反馈加以更新。 检查员会积累调查员发出的电话,把电话保留在附加说明的间隔内,选择带有互动反馈的回复,以便进行特许的提炼,修改其报告规则技能卡,并定期刷新FSL。 精炼的检查员随后又回到后来的推出,因此该剂会从自身的环境进化.

blocks.en:
Moreover, existing forensic video datasets [ 44 , 15 , 20 ] supervise a single detector with a verdict or a holistic rationale, providing neither role-specific evidence for sub-agents nor trajectories for coordinating them. We therefore curate ForenCue-30K , which decomposes forensic supervision by role. Each record isolates one forensic perspective and specifies a verdict, a confidence, and the temporal interval of the artifact, so that a sub-agent learns to report what its role can verify, including when the evidence is inconclusive. Agentic trajectories are assembled from executed sub-agent calls rather than imagined observations, so every decision is conditioned on evidence the main agent would actually receive. An accompanying RL pool supports DTPO. Since existing benchmarks score only the final verdict, we build AgenticCue , an agentic benchmark that groups generated videos by forensic category and evaluates both detection accuracy and whether an agent invokes the relevant sub-agents.
Our contributions are threefold: • We propose DTPO , an RL algorithm in which the investigator and its inspectors co-evolve from shared interactions on fast and slow timescales. Inspectors refine their weights and skill cards on the very calls the investigator issues, so its rollouts become their curriculum. • We present WeVisForensics , an agentic video forensics framework in which a main agent adaptively dispatches inspections to the FSL. The invocation strategy and sub-agent competence are jointly learned through DTPO. • We curate ForenCue-30K , a role-structured dataset with agentic trajectories covering diverse generators, and introduce AgenticCue , the first agentic forensic benchmark that evaluates both accuracy and call precision.

blocks.en: 2 WeVisForensics Agent Framework
blocks.zh: 2个 代理框架

blocks.en: WeVisForensics treats AI-generated video detection as an investigation rather than a single act of perception. A human forensic analyst rarely judges a video from one glance: they form a hypothesis from the overall content, zoom in on the moment and the region where it can be tested, consult the appropriate specialist, and keep collecting evidence until the conclusion is supported. WeVisForensics turns this workflow into an agent system with two levels. A main agent, the investigator , plans the investigation, and a Forensic Sub-agent Library (FSL) of inspectors examines the video from complementary forensic perspectives and returns structured evidence.
blocks.zh: WeVisForensics将AI生成的视频检测视为调查,而不是单一的认知行为. 人类法医分析师很少从一目了然地判断一个视频:视频从整体内容中构成一个假设,在瞬间和可以测试的区域放大,咨询适当的专家,并不断收集证据直到结论得到支持. WeVisForensics将这个工作流程变成一个具有两个层次的代理系统. 一名主要特工,即调查员,负责计划调查,以及由视察员组成的法医分局图书馆从补充法医角度审查录像,并归还结构化证据。

blocks.en: The framework is built on three design principles. (i) Separation of planning and perception. The investigator decides what to check and where , while each inspector decides whether the artifact of its specialty is present in the requested scope. Planning thus scales with the complexity of a video, and perception remains specialized and verifiable. (ii) Role-decomposed evidence. Every inspection returns a verdict, a calibrated confidence, and a visibly grounded explanation for a single forensic perspective. Each piece of evidence can therefore be audited, supervised, and credited on its own, instead of being entangled in one free-form rationale. (iii) Evolvable components. The parts of the system whose competence depends on the changing distribution of generators, namely the investigation policy and the visual inspectors, are trained to improve from the system’s own interactions, whereas measurement-like tools stay fixed and provide a stable reference. Sec. 2.1 specifies the investigation protocol, Sec. 2.2 describes each member of the FSL, and Sec. 4 presents the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 该框架基于三个设计原则。 (i) 规划和认识的分离。 调查员决定检查的内容和地点,而每位视察员决定其专业的文物是否在所要求的范围内。 因此,规划的规模与视频的复杂性相称,感知仍然具有专门性和可核查性。 (二)角色分解证据. 每一次检查都得出一个判决、一种经校准的信任,以及对单一法医观点的明显依据的解释。 因此,每一件证据都可以自己审计、监督并贷记,而不是纠缠在一个自由形式的理由中。 (三) 可变构件. 该系统中那些其能力取决于发电机分布变化的部分,即调查政策和视觉检查员,都经过培训,以便通过系统本身的相互作用加以改进,而类似测量的工具则固定不变,并提供稳定的参考。 第2.1条具体规定了调查程序,第2.2条说明了FSL的每个成员,第4条说明了培训程序。

blocks.en: 2.1 Investigation Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.1 调查议定书

blocks.en: An investigation starts from a global overview of the video: frames sampled at approximately 1 FPS across the full duration and uniformly reduced to at most 16, each tagged with its absolute timestamp, together with the duration and an indicator of whether an audio stream is present. At every turn, the investigator emits a single structured message consisting of a reasoning field and an action. The reasoning states the current hypothesis, what the evidence gathered so far does or does not establish, and why the next inspection is informative. Before the final answer, it synthesizes all returned evidence, including contrary and inconclusive findings. The action either calls one tool with its arguments, a temporal window [ t s , t e ] [t_{s},t_{e}] for the window-based inspectors, a single timestamp for OCR, and no arguments for the whole-track audio tools, or terminates the investigation with a real/fake verdict.
blocks.zh: 调查从对视频的全球概览开始:整个期间用大约1个FPS取样帧,并统一减少到最多16个帧,每个帧都贴上绝对时间戳,以及持续时间和是否有音频流的指标。 调查人员每次发出一个结构化的信息,包括一个推理领域和一个行动。 推理陈述了目前的假设,迄今收集的证据是否成立,以及下一次检查为什么信息丰富。 在最后的答案之前,它综合了所有退回的证据,包括相反和无结论的结论. 行动要么使用一个带有其论据的工具,一个基于窗口的检查员的时间窗口[t s}s},t_{e}],一个OCR的单个时间戳,没有关于全轨音频工具的论据,要么以真实/假判决终止调查.

blocks.en: Inspector reports are dimensional and may conflict. Each visual report carries one of three verdicts, issue , no_issue , or inconclusive , with a confidence of high, medium, or low. The investigator treats inconclusive as moderate evidence that records a genuine limitation, never as a hidden decision in either direction, and treats no_text , tool failures, and purely descriptive audio profiles as neutral unless they contain a concrete inconsistency. A no_issue finding in one scope is not sufficient to establish the authenticity of the whole video, so the final verdict must integrate evidence across calls.

The appearance inspector checks texture stability under motion, the integrity of fine details and boundaries such as hair, fingers, teeth, and small objects, unexplained local changes in sharpness, ghosting or duplication, and the temporal and geometric consistency of lighting, shadows, and reflections. The physical inspector checks biological and kinematic motion, structural integrity of bodies and rigid objects, object permanence across occlusion, contact and grasping, and the dynamics of fluids and deformable materials. The commonsense inspector checks causality, contextual consistency of objects and roles, affordances, and event order. The investigator calls appearance and physical checks on most videos and reserves commonsense checks for overviews that suggest a specific semantic or causal anomaly, such as an animal performing a human task or an event whose outcome contradicts ordinary world knowledge.
All three inspectors share one reporting discipline. issue requires a concrete anomaly supported by the supplied frames, and no_issue requires the relevant content to be sufficiently observable and consistent. inconclusive is returned when the required evidence is absent, not meaningfully exercised, or obscured by sampling, blur, occlusion, or resolution. Confidence is calibrated to the strength and coverage of the evidence: a largely static subject cannot support a high-confidence physical judgment, and one clean frame cannot support a high-confidence appearance judgment. Normal cuts, camera motion, motion blur, compression, stylization, and animation are explicitly not anomalies by themselves, which prevents the inspectors from equating post-production with generation.

blocks.en: Generated videos increasingly carry synthesized speech, and an inconsistency between what is heard and what is seen is often more conspicuous than any visual artifact. The voice profile tool performs speaker diarization, separates overlapping speech, and estimates for each speaker an age, female/male/child probabilities, and arousal, dominance, and valence scores. The report is descriptive by design: a strong age or gender conflict with a clearly visible speaking face is useful supporting evidence, whereas dubbing, voice-over, and multiple speakers must be discounted. The ASR analysis tool transcribes the soundtrack with word-level timestamps and asks a frozen language model to review only concrete transcript and timing anomalies, such as robotic, uniformly spaced segments, against natural patterns such as hesitations and breathing pauses. Both tools are invoked on videos with an audio stream, typically when a speaking face or a talking-head scene is visible.
blocks.zh: 所生成的视频越来越多地携带合成语言,所听到的和所看到的不一致之处往往比任何视觉文物更明显。 语音简介工具进行扬声器的对称化,将重复的演说分开,并估计每个扬声器的年龄、女性/男性/儿童概率以及振奋性、主导性、以及价值分数。 报告从设计上讲是描述性的:有明显可见的演讲面孔的强烈年龄或性别冲突是有用的佐证,而欺骗、翻唱和多位演讲者则必须被忽略。 ASR分析工具将音轨与字级时间戳转换,并要求一个冷冻的语言模型只审查具体记录和时间异常,如机器人,统一间隔的片段,以对抗犹豫和呼吸暂停等自然规律. 这两种工具在带有音频流的视频中被引用,典型的是在说话脸或说话头的场景可见时.

blocks.en: The FSL splits into 𝒮 = 𝒮 evo ∪ 𝒮 fix \mathcal{S}=\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{evo}}\cup\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{fix}} , where 𝒮 evo \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{evo}} contains the four visual inspectors and 𝒮 fix \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{fix}} the two audio tools. Each member s ∈ 𝒮 evo s\in\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{evo}} evolves during training through two complementary channels: its LoRA adapter ϕ s \phi_{s} is distilled from the investigator’s own calls, and its skill card, a short list of Report and Ignore rules appended to the role instruction q s q_{s} , is revised by a reflector model (Sec. 4.2 ). Visual artifacts are the cues that shift most rapidly as generators improve, and the calls issued by the investigator expose exactly the inputs, scopes, and difficulty levels on which the inspectors are consulted. The audio tools and the PaddleOCR detector remain fixed: their outputs are measurements, such as speaker attributes, transcripts, and text boxes, whose meaning should not drift while the investigator learns to interpret them, and the scarcity of labeled audio forgeries would make their adaptation unreliable. The investigator itself is optimized with reinforcement learning, so the system improves both in what it asks and in what it is told.

blocks.en: Built from 30,000 curated videos, ForenCue-30K provides multi-level supervision for our framework, comprising 117,552 role-specific records for the sub-agents, 33,896 interaction trajectories for the main agent, and a 7,500-row RL pool for DTPO (Figure 4 and Table 2 ). blocks.en: 3.1 Role-Grounded Supervision Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 全面监督建设

blocks.en: Supervision is constructed in a pipeline that mirrors the structure of the agent (Figure 4 ). Each curated video is first annotated separately for every forensic role, the annotations are then converted into training records for the inspectors, and executed inspector calls are finally assembled into investigation trajectories for the investigator. Every stage keeps the same role taxonomy, so the evidence an inspector learns to report is exactly the evidence the investigator learns to request and interpret.
blocks.zh: 监督是在一个反映制剂结构的管道中进行的(图4)。 每段曲目的视频首先对每个法证角色分别附加注释,说明之后转换为检查员的培训记录,执行的检查员的电话最终集合成调查人员的调查轨迹. 每个阶段都保留着相同的角色分类学,因此一个检查员学会报告的证据正是调查员学会要求和解释的证据.

blocks.en: Instead of one holistic rationale per video, supervision is organized by forensic perspective and subdivided into fine-grained artifact dimensions. Matching the six FSL roles, we categorize artifacts into Visual appearance (26,378 records), Physical consistency (32,348), Common sense (40,246), OCR consistency (18,580), ASR analysis , and Audio profile . Visual appearance covers texture and detail integrity, boundary blending, ghosting, and the consistency of lighting, shadows, and reflections. Physical consistency covers body and object structure, kinematics, object permanence, contact, and fluid or deformable dynamics. Common sense covers causality, affordances, contextual roles, and event order, and OCR consistency covers glyph structure and the temporal stability of rendered text. The audio roles cover the plausibility of speech timing and the agreement between the voice and the visible speaker. Each record isolates one perspective and specifies a verdict (issue, no-issue, or inconclusive), a confidence, an explanation, and the temporal interval of the artifact. Real videos contribute records under the same format, so every role sees both outcomes. This balance teaches each inspector to report only what its role can verify, rather than to equate “generated” with “an artifact of my type is visible”.
blocks.zh: 监督不是每个视频一个整体的理由,而是从法医角度组织起来,细分为精细的文物维度. 与六个FSL角色相匹配,我们将文物分为视觉外观(26,378个记录),物理一致性(32,348个),常识(40,246个),OCR一致性(18,580个),ASR分析(ASR)和Audio profile(Audio profile). 视觉外观涵盖纹理和细节完整性,边界混合,幽灵,以及照明,阴影,反射的一致性. 物理一致性涵盖身体和物体结构、动能、物体的持久性、接触和流体或变形动态。 常识涵盖因果关系、负担、背景作用和事件顺序,OCR一致性涵盖甘油结构以及渲染文本的时间稳定性。 音频角色涵盖语音计时的可信度以及语音与可见的扬声器之间的约定. 每个记录都孤立了一种观点,并规定了判决(问题、无问题或无结论)、信心、解释和文物的时间间隔。 真实的视频以相同格式提供记录,因此每个角色都能看到这两个结果. 这种平衡使每个检查员只能报告其作用可以核实的情况,而不是将“生成的”等同于“我这种类型的文物是显而易见的”。

blocks.en: For each video and role, a rubric-conditioned VLM annotator examines the timestamped frames under a role-specific guideline listing the artifact dimensions above and source-provenance constraints, localizing observable artifacts within temporal intervals and writing frame-grounded explanations of what is visibly wrong. Explanations must refer strictly to observable visual evidence, and roles without visible anomalies are recorded as no-issue even on generated videos, preventing forced attribution. A cross-family VLM verifier then checks each candidate against the video and refines or rejects it, filtering hallucinated explanations, over-generalized commonsense claims, and imprecise intervals. Human reviewers inspect sampled annotations per source and role during prompt development and source onboarding, and their findings are fed back into the guidelines and filtering rules, while audio inconsistencies are annotated directly by reviewers who watch each clip with sound (Appendix B ). In a quantitative audit of 340 video–role annotations, 99.1 % 99.1\% are supported by the visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 对于每个视频和角色,一个标有标语的VLM注释器根据特定角色准则检查时间标框,列出上面的文物维度和源证据限制,将可观测文物在时间间隔内定位,并用书写框架来解释明显错误之处。 解释必须严格指向可观察到的视觉证据,没有明显反常现象的角色甚至被记录为在生成的视频上的无问题,防止强制归属. 一个跨家庭的VLM核查员然后对照视频检查每个候选者,对其进行精细或拒绝,过滤幻觉解释,过度泛泛的常识诉求,以及不准确的间隔. 人类审查员在迅速发展和源入职期间检查每个源和角色的抽样说明,并将调查结果反馈到准则和过滤规则中,而音频不一致则由用声音观看每个片段的审查员直接附加说明(附录B ). 在对340个视频-作用说明的定量审计中,99.1%的99.1+%得到了视觉证据的支持.

blocks.en: Each annotation is converted into a record whose input is exactly what the inspector observes at inference: the frames of the requested window at 2 FPS for the window-based roles, and the frame at the requested timestamp for OCR. The target is the structured report, comprising the verdict, the confidence, and an explanation that cites timestamps within the window. Because the windows are specified in absolute video time, the same annotation can supervise the inspector and later serve as the grounding interval I x , s I_{x,s} for selecting calls during DTPO.
blocks.zh: 每条注释都转换成记录,其输入内容正是检查员在推断时所观察到的:请求窗口在2 FPS为窗口角色设定的帧,以及请求为OCR设定的时间戳设定的帧. 目标是有条理的报告,包括判决、信心和援引窗口内时间戳的解释。 由于窗口在绝对视频时间中指定,同样的注释可以监督检查人员,后来作为DTPO期间选择通话的地面间隔Ix,s_{x,s}.

blocks.en: Interaction trajectories are constructed through execution-grounded synthesis. Given the video overview and verified role evidence as training-only context, a VLM trajectory planner decides which roles and temporal scopes to consult, modeling how an expert investigation prioritizes relevant checks. Every planned call is then executed by the corresponding inspector, and the planner writes the reasoning of each turn conditioned on the reports actually returned, so that the investigator never learns from imagined observations. All training-only metadata are stripped from student-facing messages, conditioning each decision strictly on inference-time observations. Trajectories cover both real and generated videos, use about two calls on average under the four-call budget, and reach 96.0 % 96.0\% appropriate tool selection in a human audit of 100 trajectories.
blocks.zh: 相互作用的轨迹是通过执行基合成构建的. 鉴于视频综述和经核实的角色证据是仅作为培训背景的,一个VLM轨迹规划员决定了哪些角色和时间范围可以参考,并模拟专家调查如何优先进行相关检查。 每一次计划中的呼叫随后都由相应的督察执行,计划者写下每个转弯的推理,以实际返回的报告为条件,这样调查员就永远无法从想象的观察中吸取教训. 所有只培训的元数据都从学生信息中删除,严格根据推断时间观察来决定。 轨迹既涵盖真实的视频,也涵盖生成的视频,在四通通预算下平均使用约2个电话,在对100个轨迹进行人力审计时,其适当工具选择率达到96.0%96.0%。

blocks.en: The name ForenCue-30K refers to the core video supervision set, while expanded annotation records, trajectories, and the accompanying RL pool are counted separately (Figure 4 ). The RL pool contains 7,500 rows spanning 15 collections and 56 source subsets, with 3,750 unique real and 3,180 unique generated clips repeated with source-dependent weights to balance labels and sources. Each generated clip carries its role-specific artifact intervals, which ground the selection of inspector calls in the slow process, and each clip carries a verified set of relevant roles, which defines the tool-coverage reward (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: ForenCue-30K这个名称指的是核心视频监督集,而扩展的注释记录,轨迹,以及配套的RL池则单独计算(图4 ). RL池包含7,500行,横跨15个集合和56个源子集,有3,750个独有的真实和3,180个独有的生成的片段重复,并带有依赖源的权重,以平衡标签和源. 每个生成的片段带有其特定角色的工艺间隔,在缓慢的进程中将选择检查员的电话,而每个片段则带有一套经过核实的相关角色,其中定义了工具覆盖奖励(第4.2条)。

blocks.en: Export checks validate record structure, role-specific fields, video duration, and the availability of sampled frames. For interaction trajectories, construction checks match call identifiers to stored responses and enforce the action budget and the protocol rules of Sec. 2.1 , and automated text checks screen the student-facing messages for training-only metadata leakage. Each trajectory record retains the video and source identifiers, sampled-frame timestamps, ordered messages, and target verdict.
blocks.zh: 出口检查验证记录结构,角色特定字段,视频持续时间,以及样本帧的可用性. 对于交互轨迹,构建检查匹配调用识别符以存储响应并执行Sec.2.1的动作预算和协议规则,自动文本检查屏蔽只培训元数据泄露的学生信息. 每个轨迹记录都保留了视频和源识别符,抽样帧时间戳,订购消息,以及目标判断.

blocks.en: 3.2 AgenticCue Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks score only the final verdict, so an agent that reaches the right answer through irrelevant inspections, or that cannot handle a particular class of artifacts, remains invisible. AgenticCue is designed to expose both. Unlike the training set, which is dominated by open-source and earlier commercial models, it targets newer-generation commercial releases (Veo 3.1, Kling 2.5/3.0, Seedance 1.5/2.0, Hailuo 2.3/H3, Wan 2.6, Sora 2, Jimeng, and HappyHorse 1.0) alongside held-out digital-human, face-swap, and voice-mismatch audio forgeries, and thus also measures generalization to generators unseen during training.
blocks.zh: 现有基准只得最终判决,因此通过无关的检查得出正确答案,或不能处理某一类文物的代理人仍然隐形. AgenticCue是用来曝光两者的. 与以开源模式和早期商业模式为主的成套培训不同,它针对的是新一代商业发行(Veo 3.1、Kling 2.5/3.0、种子1.5/2.0、Haluo 2.3/H3、Wan 2.6、Sora 2、Jimeng和HappyHorse 1.0),同时持有数字-人文、脸谱和语音-模拟音频伪造,因此也测量培训期间未见的发电机的通用情况。

blocks.en: The benchmark spans five forensic categories, Visual , Physical , OCR , Common sense , and Audio , each containing exactly 500 generated videos verified to exhibit that category’s artifact. Candidate clips are first annotated by model annotators and then confirmed by human reviewers. A clip may belong to several categories, and 170 clips do, giving 2,330 unique generated videos. All categories share the same 500 real videos, so each category forms a balanced set of 1,000 videos. None of its videos appear in ForenCue-30K.
blocks.zh: 该基准涵盖五个法医类别,分别是视觉、物理、OCR、常识和音频,每个类别都有500个生成的录像,经核实可展示该类文物。 候选人的剪辑首先由模型注释员注释,然后由人文审查员确认. 一个剪辑可能属于几个类别,170个剪辑确实如此,给出了2,330个独特的生成视频. 所有类别都共享同样的500个真实视频,因此每个类别组成了1000个视频的平衡组合. 它的视频都没有出现在ForenCue-30K中.

blocks.en: For each category, we report binary detection accuracy on its balanced set, counting invalid or missing outputs as errors. To evaluate whether the agent consults the right specialist, we additionally report invocation precision, the fraction of generated videos on which the agent invokes tool s s that actually call for role s s . The reference set of relevant roles for the four visual tools comes from dense annotations in which two cross-family VLM annotators independently mark every role worth inspecting on each generated video and a label-blind judge resolves disagreements, while for audio it is the Audio category. Table 3 lists the resulting label counts and the base rates obtained by invoking a tool on every video. Precision is always read together with accuracy, which would drop if the agent skipped relevant inspections. Details are given in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4 Training Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4 培训管道

blocks.en: WeVisForensics is trained in two stages. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on ForenCue-30K first teaches the investigator the investigation protocol and each inspector its role-specific reporting format (Sec. 4.1 ). DTPO then lets the investigator and the inspectors improve together from their own interactions (Sec. 4.2 ), and a scalable implementation keeps the joint training practical (Sec. 4.3 ). Every model is adapted with low-rank adapters on a shared backbone, so that the investigator and all inspectors can be loaded and served as one backbone plus a few lightweight adapters, and both stages update every model in the same parameterization.
blocks.zh: 我们分两个阶段进行训练。 ForenCue-30K上的监督微调(SFT)首先向调查人员教授调查协议和每个检查员具体作用的报告格式(Sec.4.1)。 DTPO然后让调查员和检查员通过自己的互动来共同改进(第4.2节),可扩展的执行使联合培训切合实际(第4.3节)。 每个型号在共享骨干上采用低级适配器进行改造,使调查员和所有检查员可以加载并充当一个骨干加上几个轻量级适配器,两个阶段都在同一参数化中更新每个型号.

blocks.en: 4.1 Stage I: Supervised Initialization
blocks.zh: 4.1 第一阶段:监督初始化

blocks.en: All models share the Qwen3.5-4B [ 31 ] backbone. The investigator and the four visual inspectors are trained as five separate rank-64 LoRA [ 11 ] adapters ( α = 128 \alpha{=}128 ) on all linear layers of the language model, and the backbone, the vision encoder, and the vision-language projector are frozen throughout, so that adaptation concentrates on forensic reasoning rather than low-level visual features.

blocks.en: The investigator is trained on the 33,896 agentic trajectories of ForenCue-30K, extended with trajectories on additional videos covering a broader range of content. blocks.en: Each visual inspector is trained on its own portion of the 117,552 role-specific records, extended with records on additional videos. Each record pairs a scoped input with a verdict, a confidence, and an evidence-grounded explanation. Real and generated videos are kept in every role, so that an inspector does not learn to report an issue by default. The inspectors follow the same adapter recipe as the investigator, with a maximum length of 32,768 tokens (16,384 for OCR, whose input is a single frame). The resulting system consists of a single backbone plus five small adapters, which makes it easy to store and serve.

blocks.en: 4.2 Stage II: DTPO

blocks.en: DTPO makes interaction experience the link between learning to request evidence and refining the inspectors that provide it. The investigator determines which inputs the inspectors encounter, and the resulting reports influence both its subsequent decisions and which interactions are selected for inspector training. Updating both at the same time would make each a moving target for the other. The fast process therefore updates only the investigator on every rollout batch, while the slow process accumulates role-specific interaction queues over multiple batches and aligns the inspectors with a slowly changing EMA teacher [ 37 ] . The updated FSL then supplies observations for later rollouts, closing the loop. Video-level labels and artifact annotations are used only during training. At inference, the learned investigator and inspectors execute the protocol of Sec. 2.1 with fixed parameters.
blocks.zh: DTPO使互动体验成为学习要求证据和完善提供证据的检查员之间的联系。 调查员确定检查专员遇到哪些投入,由此产生的报告既影响其随后的决定,又影响选择哪些互动进行检查专员培训。 两者同时更新将使各自成为对方的移动目标. 因此,快速程序只在每批推出时更新调查员,而慢程序则在多个批次上累积特定角色的交互排队,并使检查员与一个缓慢变化的EMA教师配合[37]. 随后更新的FSL为以后的推出提供观察,关闭了环路. 视频级别的标签和文物说明仅在培训期间使用. 推论,有学识的调查员和检查员用固定参数执行第2.1条的协议。

blocks.en: Correctness alone tolerates investigations that reach the right verdict through an irrelevant inspection, and such shortcuts generalize poorly to videos whose decisive artifact lies elsewhere. Each training video therefore carries a verified set of relevant forensic roles, derived from its role-specific annotations, and each trajectory receives the F1 score between this set and the set of tools it actually invoked. The F1 score is centered within the GRPO group and added to A g A_{g} with weight 0.3 0.3 after the correctness normalization, so it ranks investigations that share the same outcome without overriding correctness.

blocks.en: A correct verdict can still hinder subsequent forensic reasoning, for example an inconclusive or low-confidence report that leaves the investigator without usable evidence. The CLUE score in Eq. ( 10 ) identifies such responses: a correct response is relabeled as a hedge when c j < κ c_{j}<\kappa and its verdict is inconclusive or not stated with high confidence. False alarms, misses, and hedges are the responses whose decisions must change, while the remaining correct responses are retained so that refinement preserves decisions that are already right. The final trajectory need not be incorrect: a locally unhelpful report warrants refinement even when the investigator recovers the correct answer. All retained calls, rather than one call per prompt and role, enter role-specific queues. When a role is refreshed, its examples are arranged into batches with equal numbers of real and generated videos by subsampling the majority label.

blocks.en: Adapter updates change how an inspector perceives. Some failure modes, however, are better expressed as explicit reporting rules, for example that motion blur on fast-moving hands is not a structural defect, or that a soft object deforming under direct contact is not a physics violation. Alongside its adapter weights, each trainable inspector therefore carries a skill card [ 39 ] , a short list of Report and Ignore rules appended to its role instruction and seen by student and teacher. After each distillation round, a frozen reflector LLM reviews recent calls that the current inspector still judges wrongly, with their labels, and proposes rule edits. A candidate card replaces the current one only if it yields more correct verdicts on held-out recent calls without losing any correct verdict on either real or generated videos. This acceptance test makes card edits monotone on recent experience and prevents the reflector from trading false alarms for misses. Examples of evolved cards are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 适配器更新会改变检查员的看法。 然而,一些故障模式最好被表述为明确的报告规则,例如快速移动的手上运动模糊不是结构缺陷,或者在直接接触下变形的软物体不是物理学的违反. 因此,除了适配器的重量外,每个受过训练的检查员还携带一张技能卡[39],一份简短的报告和忽略规则清单附在其角色指示之后,并由学生和教师看到。 每轮蒸馏后,一个冷冻的反射器LLM会回顾最近一些呼吁,即现任检查员仍然用他们的标签来判断错误,并提出规则编辑. 候选人卡只有在对最近被搁置的电话作出更正确的判决,而不丧失对真实或生成的视频的任何正确判决的情况下,才能取代目前的卡片。 这种接受测试使得卡片根据最近的经验编辑单调,并阻止反射器交易错失的假警报. 进化卡的例子见附录D。

blocks.en: Training alternates rollout collection, investigator optimization, interaction selection, and periodic FSL refinement. Each batch is collected with the current main policy and a fixed inspector snapshot. After the investigator update, selected interactions enter role-specific queues. Every H H investigator steps, a synchronization barrier checks whether each queue contains enough examples to update its inspector. Eligible students are distilled, their skill cards are revised, and the new FSL snapshot is published before rollout collection resumes, while roles with insufficient examples retain their current parameters and keep their queues for the next barrier. This schedule lets the investigator learn between FSL updates while each refinement stage draws on accumulated interaction experience.
blocks.zh: 培训替代推广收集、调查员优化、互动选择和定期改进FSL。 每批货物都按现行主要政策和固定的检查员快照收集。 调查员更新后,选定的交互输入特定角色的队列. 每个 H 调查员步骤,一个同步屏障检查每个队列是否包含足够的实例来更新其检查员. 符合条件的学生被提炼,他们的技能卡被修订,新的FSL快照在推出集恢复前发布,而例子不足的角色保留其目前的参数,并保持排队状态以进入下一个障碍. 这一时间表让调查员在FSL更新之间学习,而每个完善阶段则借鉴累积的互动经验。

blocks.en: 4.3 Scalable Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.3 可扩展的执行

blocks.en: A single DTPO step runs 32 × G 32\times G multi-turn investigations, each invoking up to four inspectors on video inputs, so inspector serving and FSL refreshes dominate the cost of training. The investigator and the four visual inspectors are served by separate vLLM engines that share the training cluster, and the rollout workers execute investigations asynchronously, so that a slow audio or OCR call does not stall other trajectories in the batch. The audio tools and PaddleOCR run as independent services. At each synchronization barrier, the four inspector refreshes are packed into two parallel lanes of GPUs, one handling visual appearance followed by common sense and the other physical consistency followed by OCR, which balances the per-lane workload because the roles accumulate very different numbers of calls. Refreshed adapters are merged into the backbone weights and published to the inference engines as full checkpoints rather than hot-swapped as LoRA modules, which we found to be numerically more robust on our hardware. Skill-card revision runs after publication. With a refresh every 20 steps, the full joint schedule of a few hundred investigator steps completes in about a day on our cluster.
blocks.zh: 单个 DTPO 步骤运行 32 × G 32\ times G多轮调查,每轮最多可请4名视察员提供录像资料,因此,检查专员在服务,而FSL在培训费用中占主导地位。 调查员和四位视觉检查员由单独的vLLM引擎提供服务,共享培训集群,推出人员同步执行调查,这样一个慢音或OCR的呼叫不会在批次中阻碍其他轨迹. 音频工具和PaddleOCR作为独立服务运行. 在每个同步屏障上,四个检查员刷新器被包装成两个平行的GPU车道,一个处理视觉外观,然后是常识,另一个是OCR之后的物理一致性,它平衡了每个车道的工作量,因为角色累积的呼叫次数非常不同. 更新的适配器被合并到骨干重量中,并发布到推论引擎中作为完整的检查点,而不是作为LORA模块的热浪,我们发现这在硬件上在数字上更为坚固. 技能卡修订工作在出版后进行。 每20步刷新一次 几百个调查员步骤的完整联合时间表 大约一天后完成

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that WeVisForensics attains the strongest detection performance on both the in-domain and the out-of-domain benchmarks. On the in-domain split, binary detectors stay near chance, whereas MLLM-based detectors benefit from domain supervision, and WeVisForensics reaches 97.7%, surpassing VideoVeritas by 3.4% and ARGUS by 11.3%. On the out-of-domain splits, generic MLLMs suffer from low fake recall regardless of scale, and CoT detectors drop sharply across unseen generators. WeVisForensics ranks first on GenBuster++ at 97.5% and on the six-generator MintVid mean at 88.0%, improving over the SFT agent on every generator category, which demonstrates strong generalization to unseen generators.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,WeVisForensics在域内和域外基准上都取得了最强的检测性能. 在域内拆分时,二进制探测器几乎是偶然的,而基于MLLM的探测器则受益于域监督,WeVisForensics达到97.7%,超过VideoVeritas3.4%,ARGUS为11.3%。 在域外分裂时,通用的MLLMs无论规模大小都受到低假召回,CoT探测器在看不见的发电机之间急剧下降. WeVisForensics在GenBuster++上以97.5%位居首位,在六源MintVid上以88.0%位居首位,这比SFT在每一个发电机类别上的代理都有所改善,这表明了对隐形发电机的强烈概括。

blocks.en: The five categories of AgenticCue expose the blind spots of prior paradigms across artifact types. Generic MLLMs handle commonsense violations but miss fine-grained anomalies, as Qwen3.5-397B reaches 94.5% on commonsense but only 54.1% on audio. Lacking specialized forensic tools, CoT detectors also degrade sharply, with DeepTraceReward [ 7 ] near chance at 51.9–55.5% across all five categories and BusterX++ [ 45 ] at 49.9% on audio. In contrast, WeVisForensics stays within 97.0–98.8% across all five categories and leads VideoVeritas [ 36 ] by 27.7% on audio and 20.9% on average. DTPO improves over the SFT agent on all five categories, most on visual appearance by 4.9% and on OCR by 4.4%, demonstrating balanced detection.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 6 isolates the fast and slow components of DTPO and yields three observations. First, optimizing the main policy against a frozen library mainly fits the training distribution. GRPO gains 2.9% on GB and 2.8% on GB++ over SFT, but only 1.3% on MintVid and 0.4% on AgenticCue. Adding CLUE under the same frozen library moves the average by only 0.5%, because static sub-agents remain an evidence bottleneck. Second, slow sub-agent evolution breaks this bottleneck and drives out-of-domain transfer, lifting the average by 1.6% over GRPO, with gains of 2.3% on MintVid and 2.7% on AgenticCue. Third, action-level credit becomes effective once it is paired with an evolving library, adding a further 1.4% on MintVid and reaching the best overall average of 95.2%, ahead of SFT by 3.9% and GRPO by 2.0%. Publishing the refined library every rollout batch instead of every H = 20 H{=}20 steps also hurts transfer, lowering every unseen generator by up to 4.8% and the OOD mean by 2.0% in Table 7 . The two processes are thus complementary, provided the library is refreshed at a stable cadence.

GRPO在GB上获得2.9%的收益,在GB++上获得2.8%的收益,在SFT上获得2.8%的收益,但在MintVid上获得1.3%的收益,在AgenticCue上获得0.4%的收益. 在同一冷冻库下添加CLUE,平均移动率仅为0.5%,因为静态子剂仍然是证据瓶颈. 第二,缓慢的副剂进化打破了这个瓶颈,驱动了域外转移,平均比GRPO提高1.6%,MintVid的增益为2.3%,AgenticCue的增益为2.7%。 第三,行动信贷一旦与不断发展的图书馆配对,就会生效,在MintVid上再增加1.4%,达到95.2%的最好总体平均数,比SFT高3.9%,GPRO高2.0%。 在表7中,每批H = 20 H = 20 个步骤都会影响转移,将每个未见的生成器降低4.8%,将OOD平均降低2.0%。 因此,这两个过程是相辅相成的,只要图书馆的刷新稳定。

blocks.en: Table 7 compares DTPO with two alternative schedules from the same SFT initialization. Refreshing the library on every rollout batch lowers accuracy on all six unseen OOD generators, with drops of 4.8% on Hailuo, 2.6% on Kling, and 2.3% on Sora2, reducing the six-generator mean by 2.0% despite similar training rewards. The staged schedule first evolves the library and then freezes it while training the main agent, so both levels improve but never adapt to each other. DTPO still leads it on every unseen generator, by 2.4% on the six-generator mean, as co-evolution lifts fake recall across unseen generators from 70.2% under the staged schedule and 71.3% under every-step refresh to 74.8% while preserving 100% real-video recall. Strengthening the inspectors first or refreshing them on every batch thus fails to recover the out-of-domain transfer of two-timescale co-evolution.

DTPO仍然领先于每个不见的发电机,在六生成器的平均值为2.4%,因为共演将假召回从70.2%从舞台时间表下的70.2%和每步刷新后的71.3%提升到74.8%,同时保留100%的真召回。 因此,在每批货物中首先加强检查人员或对他们进行更新,都无法收回双倍规模的联合转移。

blocks.en: 5.4 Does Sub-agent Evolution Improve Evidence?
blocks.zh: 5.4 副代理人进化是否改进证据?

blocks.en: Video-level accuracy cannot separate a better inspection policy from better sub-agent responses. Table 8 therefore scores sub-agent calls against role-level annotations that mark which roles are worth inspecting on each test video and over which interval. Two cross-family VLM annotators label each video independently, and a label-blind judge resolves their disagreements. The evolving library sharpens the evidence of all three roles. The physical sub-agent improves on every benchmark, by 9.1–31.3%, rising from 66.5% to 97.8% on GB as its inconclusive rate falls from 26.9% to 0.3%. On the unseen MintVid generators, appearance and physical F1 rise by 7.0% and 19.2%, and OCR evidence improves on every benchmark, by up to 11.8% on GB++. A matched human review (Appendix B ) agrees, preferring the evolved responses in 65 pairs against 20 and cutting responses with any flaw from 30.5% to 8.0%. Unlike a frozen library, the evolving one thus improves the evidence itself, not only how the main agent uses it during investigation.

blocks.en: Table 5 asks whether the main agent invokes the role a video calls for. Querying every tool on every video only attains the base rate, which limits ARGUS to 78.6% on physical consistency. blocks.en: Table 9 crosses the SFT and DTPO-trained main agents with the SFT and evolved libraries, the pairings illustrated in Figure 6 . Evolving the library alone lifts the SFT investigator from 91.3% to 92.0%, and training the investigator alone reaches 93.2%. Evolving both reaches 95.2%, a gain of 3.9% that exceeds the sum of the two single-level gains by 1.3%. The two levels are therefore complementary: the trained investigator issues more targeted calls, and the evolved inspectors make each of those calls more informative.

blocks.en: Figure 5 traces the forensic library through training at three levels. At the parameter level, successive LoRA refreshes cut the missed anomalies on generated videos from 22.1% to 5.2% while false alarms on real videos also decline and verdict F1 rises from 80.3% to 93.7%, and every sub-agent errs progressively less across the early, middle, and late phases, with the OCR error falling from 24.7% to 9.3%. On the test benchmarks, the final library delivers higher evidence F1 than the frozen one along all three axes. At the prompt level, accepted skill-card edits add reporting rules to the appearance and commonsense sub-agents. At the case level, the same inspection returns different evidence over training. The early sub-agent calls each scene coherent and the agent answers real, whereas the final sub-agent names the regenerating texture, the color-shifting paint stream, or the rigid milk stream, and the agent answers fake. Figure 6 shows the same effect at the agent level, where only the evolved sub-agents confirm the artifact. The gains thus come from sub-agents that learn to report artifacts they once called coherent.

blocks.en: Figure 6 follows one generated video whose handwritten text warps as the clip proceeds. VideoVeritas dismisses the garbled text as stylistic without inspecting it, and in ARGUS the texture, lighting, and motion reports outweigh the detected text deformation. Within WeVisForensics, the SFT sub-agents judge the text structurally regular under either main agent. The evolved sub-agents flag its glyph anomalies, yet the SFT main agent still attributes them to hand-drawn styling and answers real. Only the DTPO-trained main agent, which targets its OCR inspection at the warped text at 7 s, combines this evidence into a fake verdict, so the correction requires both levels to evolve. A complete multi-turn investigation before and after evolution and further comparisons are given in Appendix E , and a full trajectory in Section 5.6 .

blocks.en: Investigation trace: repeated glyph distortion Step 1 Main agent visual_appearance[0.0--5.9 s] Reasoning. The primary hypothesis is that the sequence may contain a localized temporal rendering defect rather than a globally unstable scene. The overview shows one apparent speaker, a phone, four product boxes, and a hand moving across the foreground, so the most useful first check is a full-range visual comparison across the entire 5.875-second interval. This can establish whether object boundaries, textures, lighting, and motion remain coherent as the hand approaches and leaves the boxes. I will therefore inspect the complete range with the visual-appearance skill, using the sampled progression rather than relying on a single frame. The result should distinguish ordinary motion blur or occlusion from abrupt changes in an object’s shape or surface detail. At this stage, the repeated packaging and stable background provide useful reference points, while the moving hand remains the main area requiring scrutiny. Any anomaly found here would motivate a more targeted examination of the visible printed text. Sub-agent returns. issue (medium) . The clearest appearance concern is the unusually smooth, rendered quality of the woman’s face during the opening pointing gesture. Across the changing head positions, the forehead, cheeks, and nose retain broad, nearly textureless tonal gradients, while the eyes, eyebrows, and lip contours remain comparatively crisp. The cheek coloration also appears softly blended into the surrounding skin rather than showing comparable fine surface detail. This produces a waxy, airbrushed appearance that persists as the face moves, rather than being confined to one blurred pose. The effect is most apparent when the face is exposed between the moving arm and the phone. Confidence is medium because cosmetic smoothing and image processing can produce similar cues, and the frames do not establish a separate, unmistakable boundary failure. Step 2 Main agent ocr_consistency[@ 4.0 s] Reasoning. The preceding full-range appearance review identifies a medium-confidence concern involving the face’s unusually smooth, rendered-looking surface, but it does not establish a decisive boundary failure and leaves cosmetic processing as a plausible alternative. The remaining useful question is whether the prominent product packaging behaves like stable physical text. The overview shows four nearly identical boxes with repeated lettering, making a focused OCR-consistency check at 4.0 seconds appropriate: it can compare the legibility and structure of the printed regions while the boxes are clearly visible. This targeted scope is useful because generated imagery often produces malformed or inconsistent glyphs even when the surrounding scene appears coherent. I will use the OCR skill at that timestamp, including its localized text assessment, to test whether the repeated labels retain plausible character shapes and spacing. This evidence should be weighed alongside, rather than substituted for, the earlier appearance finding. Sub-agent returns. text suspicious (medium) . Issues: Repeated central A glyphs have unusually narrow upper structures and elongated lower diagonals; The repeated label has inconsistent character construction despite broadly similar lettering. Reason: All three crops show a recurring localized anomaly in the central A. The concern is its distorted construction, not the unusual spelling or OCR mismatch. Softness limits certainty, but the repeated structural irregularity supports a suspicious assessment. Step 3 Main agent: final verdict answer(fake) Verdict. The evidence supports a fake classification. Across the full sequence, the visual review found a persistent waxy, airbrushed quality in the woman’s face: broad textureless gradients coexist with comparatively crisp eyes, brows, and lips. This is a meaningful rendering concern, though its medium confidence and the possibility of cosmetic smoothing or image processing limit its decisiveness. The focused text review independently found recurring structural irregularities in the repeated central “A” glyphs, including narrow upper forms and elongated lower diagonals, with inconsistent character construction across similar labels. That result is also medium confidence because softness can obscure fine detail, but the anomaly recurs across multiple localized regions rather than being a single ambiguous crop. Together, the persistent facial rendering artifact and repeated malformed packaging text provide converging signs of synthetic image generation. No audio is available, so there is no speech or voice evidence to weigh. The combined visual and text inconsistencies outweigh the stated uncertainty and favor fake.
blocks.zh: 调查追踪:重复的甘油扭曲 步骤 1 主代理视觉_出现[0.0-5.9 s] 缘起故. 主要假设是,序列可能包含局部时间渲染缺陷而不是全球不稳定的场景. 综述显示一个明显的扬声器,一个电话,四个产品箱,以及一只手在前方移动,所以最有用的第一次检查是整个5.875秒间隔的全程视觉比较. 这可以确定物体的界限、纹理、照明和运动是否在手靠近并离开盒子时保持一致。 因此,我将用视觉技术检查整个范围,采用抽样进度,而不是依赖单一框架。 结果应区分普通运动模糊或隐蔽与物体形状或表面细节的突然变化。 在现阶段,反复包装和稳定的背景提供了有用的参考点,而移动的手仍然是需要审查的主要领域。 这里发现的任何异常情况都会促使对可见的印刷文本进行更有针对性的检查。 副使归. 问题(中型) 最清楚的外表问题是,在开场时,妇女的面部表现异常光滑。 在头部位置的变化中,额头、脸颊和鼻部保留着宽阔、几乎无纹理的直肠梯度,而眼睛、眉毛和唇轮廓则保持相对柔软。 颊部的颜色也显得柔软地混合到周围的皮肤中,而不是表现出类似的细细的表面细节. 这产生了蜡质的,空气刷的外观,随着面部移动而持续存在,而不是局限于一个模糊的姿势. 当面部暴露在移动手臂和电话之间时,效果最为明显. 置信度是中等的,因为化妆品平滑和图像处理可以产生相似的提示,帧不能建立单独的,不可模糊的边界故障. 步骤2 主要代理 OCR_一致性 [@ 4.0 s] 原因. 前面的全程外观审查确定了一种中度的自信关切,涉及面部异常光滑、外观变质的表面,但它没有确定决定性的边界故障,并留下化妆品加工作为可行的替代办法。 剩下的有用的问题是,突出的产品包装是否表现得像稳定的物理文字. 概览显示有四个几乎完全相同的盒子,并反复写字母,在4.0秒的合适时间进行集中的OCR-一致性检查:可以比较打印区域的清晰度和结构,而盒子则清晰可见. 这种有针对性的范围是有用的,因为即使周围的场景看起来是连贯的,生成的图像也往往产生畸形或不一致的格言. 我将使用OCR在那个时间戳的技能,包括其本地化的文字评估,来测试重复的标签是否保留了可信的字符形状和间隔. 在权衡这些证据的同时,不应取代先前的出庭调查结果。 副使归. 文本可疑(中等) 。 问题:重复的中心 格子上部结构异常狭小,下部对角线长; 重复的标签虽然字母写法大致相似,但字符构造不一致. 原因: 所有三种作物都显示出中部A区反复出现的局部异常. 关注的是它的扭曲构造,而不是不寻常的拼写或OCR不匹配. 软性限制了确定性,但重复的结构不规则性支持了可疑的评估. 第3步 主要代理人:最终判决答案(假)判决. 证据支持假分类. 在全程中, 视觉评论发现女性面部具有持续的蜡质、空气刷新的质量: 宽大的无纹度梯度与相对柔软的眼睛、眉毛和嘴唇共存。 这是一种有意义的关切,尽管其中度信心和化妆品平滑或图像处理的可能性限制了其决定性。 重点文字审查独立地发现,重复的中央“A”格法中一再出现结构上的不合规定之处,包括狭长的上方形式和斜线较长的下方对角体,在相似的标签上字符构造不一致。 这一结果也是中度信心,因为软性可以模糊细节,但异常现象在多个局部地区重复发生,而不是单一的模棱两可的作物。 持续的面部渲染工艺品和重复的不良包装文本共同提供了合成图像生成的趋同迹象。 无法获取音频,因此没有语音或语音证据可以衡量. 合并的视觉和文字不一致之处超过了所说的不确定性,倾向于伪造。

blocks.en: Investigation trace: airborne sleigh Step 1 Main agent common_sense[9.4--15.1 s] Reasoning. The visible sequence presents a highly unusual airport event: a decorated passenger aircraft appears to be moving alongside a large Santa sleigh filled with gifts. Before assessing whether the imagery is physically credible, it is useful to test the scene against ordinary event logic. The key hypothesis is that the apparent flight may be a staged visual effect, a composited sequence, or an AI-generated depiction rather than a genuine recording. This common-sense review should examine whether the aircraft, sleigh, airport infrastructure, and their apparent relationship form a plausible real-world scenario. It should also distinguish merely fantastical subject matter from contradictions in the depicted event, such as unsupported objects, unexplained attachments, or actions that require impossible mechanics. The selected interval covers the transition from the close ground-level views to the wider airborne views, making it appropriate for evaluating the central causal claim without relying only on isolated visual artifacts. Sub-agent returns. issue (high) . The scene depicts a commercial passenger aircraft taking off from an airport runway while carrying a large red sleigh filled with presents and a Santa-like figure. The sleigh is positioned behind the aircraft and appears to travel with it, but no visible mechanism explains how the sleigh is attached, supported, or propelled. The aircraft’s ordinary flight behavior is therefore combined with an unexplained passenger-carrying vehicle that has no plausible operational role in the scene. The Christmas trees and decorations fit a festive theme, but they do not provide a causal explanation for the sleigh’s movement or the aircraft’s unusual load. The event is clearly visible across multiple frames, making the semantic and causal inconsistency sufficiently observable. Step 2 Main agent physical_consistency[9.4--15.1 s] Reasoning. The preceding semantic review identifies a strong causal concern: the sleigh appears to accompany the aircraft without an evident explanation for its support or propulsion. That finding supports a more focused physical examination, but it does not by itself establish whether the apparent motion is a practical stunt, an edit, or generated imagery. The next useful test is therefore physical consistency across the same late sequence. This review should track the aircraft’s trajectory, the sleigh’s position and orientation, the apparent connection between them, and whether their motion remains mechanically coherent as the camera perspective changes. It should also check for continuity in the aircraft’s structure and the sleigh’s relationship to the surrounding airport environment. Because the available interval is sampled rather than continuous, the assessment should remain attentive to uncertainty about unseen attachment points, forces, and intermediate motion, while still determining whether the visible dynamics provide a credible real-world explanation. The sleigh appears to travel alongside and then behind the aircraft while remaining suspended above the tarmac, with no visible support, propulsion, or mechanically credible connection. Across the sequence, the aircraft rises and advances while the sleigh stays at a similar height and follows a separate path, despite the apparent proximity and alignment suggesting a shared movement. The sleigh also passes close to the aircraft without a clear collision response or consistent depth relationship. The reindeer antlers on the aircraft are visible, but they do not provide a plausible mechanism for pulling or carrying the sleigh. These are clear violations of contact, trajectory, and object-motion consistency rather than ordinary camera movement or a normal airport maneuver. The common-sense assessment finds that a commercial passenger aircraft appears to take off while carrying or traveling with a large red sleigh and Santa-like figure, but no visible mechanism explains how the sleigh is supported, attached, or propelled. blocks.zh: 调查追踪:空中雪橇第一步 常见的主要剂 [9.4-15.1 s] 缘起故. 可见的序列呈现出一个非常不寻常的机场事件:有装饰的客机似乎正与装满礼物的圣诞老人大雪橇同时移动. 在评估图像在物理上是否可信之前,根据普通事件逻辑来测试现场是有用的. 关键假说是,明显的飞行可能是舞台视觉效果,复合序列,或者AI生成的描写,而不是真实的录音. 这一常识性审查应审查飞机、雪橇、机场基础设施及其明显的关系是否构成一种可信的现实世界情景。 它还应当将仅是奇幻主题与所描述的事件中的矛盾区分开来,例如没有支持的对象,无法解释的附着物,或者需要不可能的力学的行动. 选定的间隔涵盖从接近地面的视野向更广泛的空中视野的过渡,使得它适合评价中央因果关系主张,而不只依靠孤立的视觉文物. 副使归. 问题(高). 该场景描绘一架商用客机在搭载一个装满礼物和类似圣诞老人的大型红色雪橇时从机场跑道起飞. 雪橇位于飞机后方,似乎随飞机出行,但没有任何明显的机制来解释雪橇是如何被附着,支撑或推进的. 因此,飞机的正常飞行行为与一种无法解释的载客车辆结合在一起,在现场没有可信的操作作用。 圣诞树和装饰符合节日主题,但并没有为雪橇运动或飞机异常载荷提供因果解释. 该事件在多个框架之间明显可见,使得语义和因果不一致现象得到充分的观测. 步骤2 主要剂 物理一致性[9.4-15.1 s] 缘起故. 前面的语义审查发现了一个强烈的因果关系:雪橇似乎伴随着飞机,对其支持或推进没有明显的解释. 这一结论支持更集中的物理检查,但它本身并不确定表面运动是实际特技、编辑还是生成图像。 因此,下一个有用的检验标准是同一后期序列的物理一致性。 这一审查应跟踪飞机的飞行轨迹、雪橇的位置和方向、它们之间的明显联系,以及它们的运动是否随着镜头角度的变化而保持机械上的一致性。 它还应检查飞机结构的连续性和雪橇与周围机场环境的关系。 由于现有时间间隔是抽样的而不是连续的,因此评估应当继续注意对不可见附件点、力量和中间运动的不确定性,同时仍然决定可见的动态是否提供了可信的现实世界解释。 副使归. 问题(高). 飞机和雪橇没有实际可行的联系或移动关系。 雪橇似乎与飞机并肩飞行,然后在停机坪上悬浮,没有明显的支持、推进或机械上可信的连接。 在整个序列中,飞机上升和前进,而雪橇则停留在相似高度上,并走一条单独的路径,尽管明显接近和对齐表明有共同移动. 雪橇也经过飞机附近,没有明显的碰撞反应或一致的深度关系. 飞机上的驯鹿鹿角是显而易见的,但它们没有为拉或搭载雪橇提供可信的机制。 这些显然违反了接触、轨迹和物体运动的一致性,而不是普通的相机移动或正常的机场操作。 第3步 主要代理人:最终判决答案(假)判决. 这两项分析都独立地找出了中央活动中的高度自信问题. 常识评估发现,一架商业客机似乎在搭载或乘坐大型红色雪橇和类似圣诞老人的人物时起飞,但没有明显的机制解释雪橇是如何支撑,附着,或推进的. 物理一致性评估强化了这一点:雪橇在保持类似高度的同时遵循一条单独的路径,缺乏可信的接触或运动关系,在飞机附近经过时没有一致的深度或碰撞反应. 鹿角是装饰性的,没有提供可信的拉动机制. 节日装饰和机场布置在隔离状态下是连贯的,但并不能解决不可能的负载和运动. 虽然抽样的帧使得一些中间行为无法观察,但在整个间隔期间反复出现的因果和物理矛盾是巨大的. 因此,媒体最好归类为假媒体。

blocks.en: 6.1 AI-Generated Video Detection
blocks.zh: 6.1 AI-Gened视频检测

blocks.en: Early detectors treat the task as binary classification over generation traces in images [ 41 , 27 , 43 , 35 ] and videos [ 2 , 5 , 54 , 13 , 22 ] , outputting a score without verifiable evidence, and benchmarks such as GVD [ 2 ] , GenVideo [ 5 ] , GenVidBench [ 26 ] , and AIGVDBench [ 24 ] scale up binary evaluation across generators. Building on MLLM-based image forensics [ 14 , 53 , 21 , 51 , 12 ] , recent video detectors pair each verdict with a natural-language account of the observed artifacts. Methods such as BusterX [ 44 ] , BusterX++ [ 45 ] , and VidGuard-R1 [ 28 ] train this reasoning with reinforcement learning, while Skyra [ 20 ] , VideoVeritas [ 36 ] , and VidForensics-M1 [ 23 ] strengthen it with artifact grounding, perception pretext tasks, and temporal-grounding rewards, respectively. IVY-FAKE [ 15 ] and Omni-Fake [ 18 ] provide annotated data for explainable detection, while OmniVL-Guard [ 34 ] unifies detection and grounding across text, images, and videos. However, these detector-centered formulations do not learn when to request a specialized follow-up inspection or how to adapt it to intermediate observations.

blocks.en: 6.2 Agent-Based Forensic Reasoning
blocks.zh: 6.2 基于代理人的法医理由

blocks.en: General video agents query specialized models to gather evidence over long inputs [ 42 , 48 , 19 ] , while forensic agents organize analysis through explicit tools or specialized roles. Tool-augmented detectors such as ClueAegis [ 4 ] , OmniVL-Guard Pro [ 33 ] , and TUE-Detector [ 47 ] train a single MLLM to invoke specific toolchains or visual operations such as cropping, zooming, and segmentation. Multi-agent methods such as SafeGuard [ 46 ] , Hermes [ 17 ] , and DVAR [ 30 ] instead distribute evidence extraction, verification, and deliberation across specialized agents. ARGUS [ 56 ] and Deepfake-Agent [ 9 ] further train a judge or aggregator over fixed expert agents. However, the invoked experts in these designs never learn from the interactions they serve while the coordinating policy is trained, leaving the experts’ forensic response policies outside the ongoing policy-learning loop.
blocks.zh: 一般视频代理商查询专业模型,以收集长时间输入的证据[42,48,19],而法医代理商则通过明确的工具或专门的角色组织分析. ClueAegis [4],OmniVL-Guard Pro [33],TUE-探测器 [47] 等工具增强的探测器,训练一个单一的MLLM,以引用特定的工具链或视觉操作,如裁剪,缩放,分区. 诸如SafeGuard[46]、Hermes[17]和DVAR[30]等多种代理方法转而将证据提取、核查和审议分给专门代理商。 ARGUS [56]和Deepfake-Agent [9] 进一步培训一名法官或集合员,使其超越固定的专家代理。 然而,在这些设计中被援引的专家在协调政策接受培训时,从未从他们所服务的互动中吸取教训,而将专家的法证反应政策置于正在进行的政策学习循环之外。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents WeVisForensics, an agentic framework for AI-generated video detection in which an investigator coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspectors. Within this framework, DTPO is introduced to optimize the investigator on a fast timescale while refining the inspectors from its calls on a slow one. To support training and evaluation, ForenCue-30K is constructed with role-specific supervision and executed trajectories, and AgenticCue is established to assess both detection verdicts and the inspections behind them. Extensive experiments across benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WeVisForensics, highlighting the value of co-evolving the investigator with its inspectors.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍We VisForensics,这是人工智能生成的视频探测的代理框架,其中一名调查员负责协调一个自我演变的法医检查员图书馆。 在此框架内,引入了DTPO,以便在快速时间尺度上优化调查员,同时从检查专员的缓慢呼唤中提炼检查专员。 为了支持培训和评价,ForenCue-30K的建设具有特定角色的监督和执行轨迹,AgenticCue的建立是为了评估检测结果及其背后的检查。 跨基准的广泛实验表明We VisForensics公司的有效性,突出了调查员与其检查员共同参与的价值。

blocks.en: Role-specific evidence annotations and main-agent interaction trajectories are produced by model annotators and coupled with human feedback (Figure 4 ) before entering the training records of Section 3 . During prompt development and source onboarding, human reviewers inspect sampled annotations per source and role, flagging hallucinated explanations, over-generalized commonsense claims, imprecise temporal windows, or redundant/omitted tool calls. These failure modes are fed back to refine the annotation prompts and filtering rules, while unplayable clips are discarded. For the audio role, reviewers work through a per-source queue, watch each video with its audio, and record whether the soundtrack is inconsistent with the visible speech along with the offending interval (Figure 11(a) ).

blocks.en: To quantify the quality of the resulting supervision in ForenCue-30K, we conduct two model-assisted human verification audits (fixed random seed 42 42 ), summarized in Figure 10 : • Sub-agent role annotations (Figure 10(a) ): We audit 340 340 video–role annotations on 100 100 generated training videos across all four visual specialist roles ( 100 100 Visual appearance , 100 100 Physical consistency , 100 100 Common sense , and 40 40 OCR consistency on clips). For each video–role pair, the auditor watches the full video and rates the distilled verdict, temporal interval, and explanation as Correct & Supported (accurately describes a visually observable artifact within the stated window), Partially Correct (appropriate verdict with minor explanation or boundary imprecision), or Incorrect (hallucinated or contradicted by the video). Overall, 99.1 % 99.1\% ( 337 / 340 337/340 ) of the role annotations are at least partially supported by visual evidence ( 94.7 % 94.7\% [ 322 / 340 322/340 ] fully supported and 4.4 % 4.4\% [ 15 / 340 15/340 ] partially correct), with only 0.9 % 0.9\% ( 3 / 340 3/340 ) judged incorrect ( 99.0 % 99.0\% supported on Visual , 99.0 % 99.0\% on Physical , 100.0 % 100.0\% on Common sense , and 97.5 % 97.5\% on OCR ). • Main-agent tool-selection trajectories (Figure 10(b) ): We audit 100 100 deduplicated main-agent SFT trajectories (comprising 209 209 sub-agent invocations across the six forensic roles). For each trajectory, the auditor watches the video with audio, inspects the sequence of invoked tools and returned observations, and judges whether the tool selection is appropriate or suffers from omitted or redundant role invocations. Across the 100 100 trajectories, 96.0 % 96.0\% ( 96 / 100 96/100 ) are judged to have appropriate tool selection ( 98.0 % 98.0\% [ 49 / 50 49/50 ] on generated videos and 94.0 % 94.0\% [ 47 / 50 47/50 ] on real videos). blocks.en: Verdict accuracy alone does not show whether evolution improves the evidence a sub-agent reports. We pair 200 200 inspections from the evaluation benchmarks, each answered by the SFT and the evolved sub-agent under the same main agent and inspection window. The pairs are stratified by role, video label, and verdict agreement. A reviewer sees both responses in random order with model identities hidden (Figure 11(b) ), marks which response gives more accurate evidence, and flags in each response unsupported or mislocalized claims and missed visible anomalies. A second reviewer re-checks the judgments. The evolved sub-agents are preferred in 65 65 pairs against 20 20 , and the share of responses with any flaw falls from 30.5 % 30.5\% to 8.0 % 8.0\% (Table 10 ). Missed anomalies drop from 28.6 % 28.6\% to 2.5 % 2.5\% and nearly vanish for appearance, physical, and OCR alike, while unsupported claims stay rare. Where the two verdicts agree, neither response is rated better in 97 97 of 100 100 pairs, so evolution leaves consistent evidence intact and its gains concentrate on the inspections it changes.
blocks.zh: 仅凭判断准确性并不能显示演化是否改善了子代理报告的证据. 我们从评价基准中配对了200次检查,每次检查都由SFT和在同一主要代理人和检查窗口下演化出来的副代理人回答. 双方按照角色,视频标签,以及判决协议进行分级. 审查者以随机顺序看到有模式身份隐藏的两种反应(图11(b)),反应给出更准确证据的标记,并在每个反应中标出不支持或错位的主张和缺失的可见异常. 第二审审者复检判决. 进化的副剂在65个65对20对20中优先,任何缺陷的答复比例从30.5%-30.5%-%降至8.0%-8.0-%(表10)。 错失的异常从28.6% 28.6 %下降到2.5 % 2.5 %, 几乎因外观、身体和OCR而消失, 而无根据的主张却很少出现。 在两个判决一致的情况下,在100对中,97对97的答复评分都好,因此演化使得一致的证据完好无损,其收益集中在它改变的检查上.

blocks.en: Appendix C Detailed Detection Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 检测结果

blocks.en: This section expands the main comparisons along two axes: the quality of the evidence returned by individual sub-agents (Table 8 ), and detection accuracy, fake recall, and F1 across benchmarks and generator categories (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 本节按照两个轴线扩展主要比较:单个子代理返回的证据的质量(表8),以及检测准确性、假召回和F1跨基准和发生器类别(表12)。

blocks.en: Evolving the library improves the evidence returned by every trainable role (Table 8 ). The physical sub-agent moves the most, with F1 on GB rising from 66.5% to 97.8%, and the largest gains of the appearance and OCR sub-agents reach 7.0% and 11.8%.
blocks.zh: 图书馆的发展改进了每个可训练角色返回的证据(表8)。 物理副剂移动最多,GB上的F1从66.5%上升到97.8%,外观和OCR副剂的最大收益达到7.0%和11.8%.

blocks.en: Three patterns explain these gains. First, the physical sub-agent stops hedging. Its inconclusive rate falls on every benchmark, from 26.9% to 0.3% on GB, 12.3% to 0.9% on GB++, 10.5% to 1.2% on MintVid, and 6.4% to 0.4% on AgenticCue, and its F1 rises by 9.1–31.3%. This matches the slow process, which relabels correct but inconclusive low-utility answers as hedges. Second, appearance evidence becomes more decisive. The share of annotated generated calls it flags rises from 96.0% to 99.8% on GB and from 66.0% to 76.2% on MintVid, and its MintVid F1 rises by 7.0%. Third, OCR evidence becomes sharper, with F1 rising on every benchmark and most on GB++ by 11.8%. The gains on the out-of-distribution MintVid, 7.0% for appearance and 19.2% for physical, show that the evolved evidence transfers to unseen generators.
blocks.zh: 三种模式解释了这些收益。 一,物理副剂停止套期. 其未确定的比率从26.9%下降到0.3%,从GB++下降到0.9%,从MintVid下降到1.2%,从AgenticCue下降到6.4%到0.4%,其F1增长了9.1-31.3%。 这与缓慢的过程相匹配,它将正确但无定论的低效用答案重新标注为套期. 第二,外观证据变得更加决定性。 附加说明生成的调用比例在GB上从96.0%升至99.8%,在MintVid上从66.0%升至76.2%,其MintVid F1则上升7.0%. 第三,OCR证据变得更加尖锐,F1在每个基准上上升,大多数在GB++上上升了11.8%. 分散式MintVid的增益,外观的增益7.0%,物理的增益19.2%,表明演化后的证据转移到隐形发电机.

blocks.en: Relative to the SFT agent, DTPO improves accuracy on all six MintVid categories and all five AgenticCue categories (Table 12 ), including an OCR fake-recall increase from 95.0% to 98.4%. Fake recall alone can be misleading. Gemini-3.1-Pro and DeepTraceReward label almost every video as generated, reaching 99.0% and 99.5% fake recall on GB++ but only 54.3% and 58.8% accuracy, whereas WeVisForensics keeps 97.2% fake recall at 97.5% accuracy. Across the 13 evaluated categories, WeVisForensics ranks first in both accuracy and F1 on 12. The largest gains over the SFT agent appear on the unseen MintVid generators, where accuracy rises by 7.5% on Kling, 6.5% on Sora2, and 5.1% on Hailuo.
blocks.zh: 相对于SFT剂,DTPO提高了所有六个MintVid类和所有五个AgenticCue类(表12)的精度,包括OCR假召回率从95.0%提高到98.4%。 单凭假召回可能让人产生误解。 双子座-3.1-Pro和DeepTrace Reward几乎每个生成的视频都贴上标签,在GB++上达到99.0%和99.5%的假召回,但只有54.3%和58.8%的准确度,而WeVisForensics则将97.2%的假召回率保持在97.5%的准确度. 在13个被评价的类别中,WeVisForensics在准确性方面排名第一,F1在12. 对SFT剂的最大收益出现在看不见的MintVid发电机上,其精度在Kling上上升7.5%,在Sora2上上升6.5%,在Hailuo上上升5.1%。

blocks.en: Appendix D Learned Skill Cards
blocks.zh: 附录D 学习技能卡

blocks.en: This section lists the complete skill cards learned by the forensic library across four training runs. Each rule is appended to the user prompt of the corresponding sub-agent alongside the inspection query. Report rules specify generation artifacts to flag, while Ignore rules describe benign camera, motion, or compression effects that should not be mistaken for synthesis errors. The learned rules are local and contrastive. A typical Report rule describes an artifact against an intact reference in the same frame, such as a single fused glyph among sharp neighboring characters or melting facial contours against a sharp background, and the matching Ignore rule names the global degradation that produces a similar look, such as uniform blur or compression across the whole region. Because each edit is mined from calls that the current inspector still judges wrongly, the cards are specific to the failures of that run and differ in concrete content across runs. For example, the physical card of Run 2 targets finger articulation and garment topology, whereas that of Run 3 targets rigid tools sliding over granular surfaces and morphing sculptures.
blocks.zh: 本节列出法医图书馆在四次培训中学习的完整的技能卡。 每项规则附在检查查询的同时,对应子代理的用户提示上. 报告规则指定了要标注的生成文物,而忽略规则则描述良性相机,运动,或压缩效果,不应误认为是合成错误. 学到的规则是地方性的,具有对比性。 一个典型的"报告规则"描述的是一件文物与同一帧中完整无缺的参照物,例如尖锐的相邻字符之间的单一熔化格莱弗或者在尖锐的背景下熔融的面部轮廓,以及匹配的"忽略规则"命名产生类似外观的全球降解,例如整个区域的统一模糊或压缩. 由于每次编辑都来自现任检查员仍然错误判断的电话,所以卡片是针对这种运行失败的,在具体内容上各行各业有所不同。 例如,Run 2的物理卡片以手指表达和服装地形为对象,而Run 3的物理卡片则以在颗粒表面和形态雕塑上滑动的刚性工具为对象。

blocks.en: Run 1
blocks.zh: 运行 1

blocks.en: Appearance 6 rules R1. Report: Surfaces exhibiting broad, continuous color gradients that completely lack fine micro-texture while adjacent objects retain sharp, distinct edges. R2. Ignore: Uniform frame-wide softness or compression artifacts that affect the entire scene equally without local texture loss. R3. Ignore: Motion blur or softness on moving subjects caused by camera movement or subject velocity. R4. Ignore: Smooth skin surfaces resulting from shallow depth of field, distance, or soft natural lighting that lacks harsh specular highlights. R5. Report: Facial skin that exhibits a uniform, airbrushed finish lacking pores or micro-texture while adjacent hair and background retain sharp detail. R6. Ignore: Silhouetted subjects in strong backlight where facial features are obscured by deep shadow and low contrast.
blocks.zh: 外观6条 R1. 报告: 表面呈现宽广连续的颜色梯度,完全缺乏细微的微纹理,而相邻物体则保留尖锐,鲜明的边缘. R2. 忽略:统一框宽软度或压缩文物,同等影响整个场景而不会失去局部纹理. R3. 忽略:由相机移动或主题速度引起的移动对象的运动模糊或柔软. R4. 忽略:光滑的皮肤表面由浅水深的田间,距离,或缺乏严酷光谱亮度的软自然照明所产生. R5. 报告:显示制服、空气刷的面部皮肤完成缺乏毛孔或微纹,而相邻的头发和背景则保持尖锐的细节。 R6. 忽略:在强烈的背光下,面部特征被深影和低反照度所模糊.

blocks.en: Physical 6 rules R1. Report: Rigid objects that change structural shape, length, or thickness during continuous motion or camera panning. R2. Ignore: Low-resolution softness or motion blur that makes fine details like fingers or distant rigging indistinct. R3. Report: A body or object that exits a frame or vanishes from view without a continuous, physically plausible trajectory. R4. Ignore: Soft edges or motion blur on small, fast-moving subjects that make their fine structure indistinct. R5. Report: A subject’s position or pose that shifts abruptly or discontinuously without a corresponding continuous motion trajectory. R6. Ignore: Smooth, mannequin-like continuity of a subject’s pose or body during camera movement or panning.
blocks.zh: 实体6规则 R1. 报告: 在连续运动或照相机平整过程中改变结构形状、长度或厚度的硬物体。 R2. 忽略:低分辨率软度或运动模糊度,使手指或远程操纵模糊等细微细节产生. R3. 报告: 一个身体或物体离开一个框架,或者从视野消失,而没有连续的,物理上可信的轨迹. R4. 忽略: 软边缘或运动模糊在小的,快速移动的主体上,使其细微的结构模糊不清. 5. 报告: 被试者的位置或姿势突然或不连续地移动,没有相应的连续运动轨迹. R6. 忽略:在照相机移动或平板时,一个对象的姿势或身体的平滑、类似模特的连续性。

blocks.en: OCR 6 rules R1. Report: Legible text where a single glyph’s strokes fuse into a malformed shape while neighboring glyphs remain structurally intact. R2. Ignore: Small, distant, or defocused text where soft edges and low resolution uniformly obscure all stroke details. R3. Report: Text where internal counters or stroke junctions melt into illegible blobs despite the surrounding letters staying sharp. R4. Ignore: Text where soft edges and low contrast uniformly obscure stroke details across the entire region without localized glyph fusion. R5. Report: A glyph whose internal topology is illegible while adjacent characters in the same string remain structurally sharp. R6. Ignore: Text on a curved or angled surface where perspective foreshortening or motion blur softens the entire region.
blocks.zh: OCR 6规则 R1. 报告: 如果一个格莱弗的中风在邻居的格莱弗结构上保持完好的情况下, R2. 忽略:小的、遥远的或分散焦点的文本,其中软边和低分辨率统一模糊了所有中风细节。 R3. 报告: 文本中,内部的计数器或中风交叉点会溶化成无法辨认的blobs,尽管周围的字母保持尖锐. R4. 忽略:文字中,软边和低反差统一模糊的中风细节贯穿整个区域,而不进行局部化的甘油聚变. 5. 报告: 其内部地形无法辨识,而同一字符串中的相邻字符在结构上仍然尖锐. R6. 忽略: 曲线或角度表面的文字,其中前景变短或运动模糊了整个区域。

blocks.en: Commonsense 5 rules R1. Report: Objects that appear, disappear, or deform without a physical cause or visible interaction. R2. Report: Animals standing upright or performing human-like coordinated actions without visible support. R3. Ignore: Blurry motion, camera shake, or low resolution that preserves the scene’s spatial coherence. R4. Report: A hand gesture or minor action triggering rapid, large-scale environmental changes like seasonal shifts. R5. Ignore: Distant or small body parts that appear indistinct due to camera distance or resolution.
blocks.zh: 常识五项规则 R1. 报告: 物体出现,消失,或变形,没有物理原因或可见的相互作用. R2. 报告:动物站立不动,或在没有明显支持的情况下开展类似人类的协调行动。 R3. 忽略: 保持场景空间一致性的模糊运动、相机摇动或低分辨率。 R4. 报告: 手势或小动作引发季节性转移等快速,大规模环境变化. R5. 忽略:由于相机距离或分辨率而显得模糊的异形或小体部分.

blocks.en: Run 2
blocks.zh: 运行 2

blocks.en: Appearance 5 rules R1. Report: Skin surfaces that are perfectly matte and textureless, lacking the natural sheen or specular highlights expected from lighting on adjacent hair or fabric. R2. Report: Metallic or glass object surfaces that display perfectly clean, band-like highlights lacking micro-scratches or environmental noise. R3. Ignore: General motion blur or soft focus on hands and objects during rapid movement or interaction. R4. Report: Soft, amorphous organic material that shifts shape or internal texture across frames without matching physical deformation or environmental cues. R5. Ignore: Uniformly smooth or airbrushed skin appearance caused by cosmetic filters or heavy compression on a moving subject.
blocks.zh: 外观5条 R1. 报告: 皮肤表面完美无瑕,缺乏在相邻的毛发或织物上照明所期望的天然的外壳或光谱亮度. R2. 报告:金属或玻璃物体表面显示完全干净的、带状的突出点,缺乏微震荡或环境噪音。 R3. 忽略:在快速移动或互动过程中,一般运动模糊或软聚焦手和物体. R4. 报告: 柔软的,非形态的有机材料,在不匹配物理变形或环境提示的情况下,使形状或内部纹理横跨框架. R5. 忽略:由化妆品滤波器或对移动对象的重压导致的统一光滑或空气刷面.

blocks.en: Physical 5 rules R1. Report: Fingers or hands that melt, overlap, or lack consistent joint articulation during continuous gestures. R2. Report: A new structural element or object that emerges from the image boundary or background without a visible path. R3. Ignore: Motion blur or soft focus on limbs during fast movement that does not alter underlying limb geometry. R4. Ignore: Volumetric smoke or dust that expands, shifts, or dissipates smoothly over time without distorting nearby rigid structures. R5. Report: A body or garment silhouette that morphs, truncates, or changes topology across frames without a continuous deformation path.
blocks.zh: 实体5规则 R1. 报告: 手指或手在连续的手势中熔化、重叠或缺乏连贯的连结。 R2. 报告: 从图像边界或背景中出现的新结构元素或对象,没有可见路径. R3. 忽略:运动模糊或软焦于四肢在快速移动时不会改变基本四肢几何. R4. 忽略:在不扭曲附近僵硬结构的情况下,随时间推移而迅速膨胀、移动或散散去的卷烟或粉尘。 5. 报告: 身体或衣物的圆形,可以变形,折断,或改变跨框架的地形,而无连续的变形路径.

blocks.en: Commonsense 5 rules R1. Report: Biological growth or developmental changes that complete in seconds. R2. Ignore: Anthropomorphic or fantastical staging where physical object permanence and interaction remain consistent. R3. Ignore: Stylized visual effects, explosions, or animated sequences with coherent internal causality. R4. Report: A person or animal interacting with a large object or creature without visible physical support or a plausible mechanism. R5. Report: A scene where the physical scale of a character is inconsistent with the surrounding environment or other objects.
blocks.zh: 常识五项规则 R1. 报告:以秒计完成的生物生长或发育变化。 R2. 忽略:在物理物体的持久性和相互作用始终一致的情况下进行反常或奇异的中转。 R3. 忽略:具有连贯内部因果关系的凝视效果,爆炸,或动画序列. R4. 报告: 一个人或动物与大型物体或生物相互作用,没有明显的物理支持或可信的机制。 5. 报告: 一个角色的物理尺度与周围环境或其他物体不一致的场景.

blocks.en: Run 3
blocks.zh: 运行 3

blocks.en: Appearance 3 rules R1. Ignore: Soft skin texture on faces caused by shallow depth of field or soft studio lighting. R2. Report: Smooth, textureless skin on hands or faces that contrasts with sharp edges on nearby clothing or objects. R3. Report: Foreground subjects with unnaturally clean, bright edges against a uniformly blurred or low-detail background.
blocks.zh: 外观3条 R1. 忽略 : 浅深的球场或软工作室照明导致面部有柔软的皮肤纹理. R2. 报告:手或脸部的光滑、无纹理皮肤与附近衣服或物体的锋利边缘形成对比。 R3. 报告:前景主体在统一模糊或低细节背景下具有非自然清洁,明亮的边缘。

blocks.en: Physical 6 rules R1. Ignore: Soft or shifting fabric boundaries where the hem blends with sand, shadows, or low-contrast ground textures. R2. Ignore: Apparent scene or subject stillness in aerial or wide shots caused by slow movement or frame sampling. R3. Report: Rigid tools or instruments that slide across granular surfaces without producing corresponding material displacement. R4. Report: Rigid anatomical forms or sculptures whose contours, limbs, or surface geometry morph or warp across frames. R5. Ignore: Smoke, steam, or fire plumes that shift, split, or change color due to wind or turbulence. R6. Ignore: Apparent limb elongation or sharp joint angles caused by camera perspective or dynamic posing.
blocks.zh: 实体6规则 R1. 忽略 : 当母鸡与沙子,阴影,或低孔的地面纹理混合时,柔软或移动的织物边界. R2. 忽略:由于移动缓慢或帧采样导致空中或广射的表面或物体静态。 R3. 报告: 硬性工具或仪器,可以滑过颗粒表面而不会产生相应的物质转移. R4. 报告:轮廓、四肢或表面几何形态或横跨框架的硬解剖形式或雕塑。 R5. 忽略:烟雾、蒸汽或火羽因风或动荡而转移、分裂或改变颜色。 R6. 忽略:由相机视角或动态摆放导致的明显的四肢延长或尖锐的关节角.

blocks.en: OCR 6 rules R1. Report: Legible characters whose internal strokes or counters are structurally malformed or inconsistent with standard glyph topology. R2. Ignore: Small or distant text that is uniformly blurred by scale or motion but retains stable, recognizable glyph shapes. R3. Ignore: Text printed on soft or moving surfaces where strokes appear to waver or distort due to surface deformation. R4. Ignore: Text on curved, embossed, or reflective surfaces where strokes appear warped by the underlying geometry. R5. Report: Legible text where stroke widths or counter shapes fluctuate irregularly between adjacent characters. R6. Report: Legible text where character spacing or stroke junctions are irregularly inconsistent within the same word.
blocks.zh: OCR 6 规则 R1. Report: 其内部中风或计数器结构畸形或与标准格律地形不一致的可修正字符. R2. 忽略:小文本或远文本因尺度或运动而统一模糊,但保留稳定、可识别的格氏形状。 R3. 忽略:印在软或移动表面的文字,其中中风因表面变形而显得动摇或扭曲. R4. 忽略:在曲线、浮雕或反射表面的文字,其中中风似乎被底部几何扭曲。 5. 报告: 在相邻字符之间,中风宽度或反向形状不规则波动的可修正文本. R6. 报告:同一字内字符间隔或中风交叉不规则不一致的可修正文本。

blocks.en: Commonsense 3 rules R1. Report: A spilled or broken item appearing on the floor without a visible drop, collision, or contact event. R2. Report: A person’s facial expression or body posture that remains unnaturally static while the surrounding environment changes. R3. Ignore: Low-resolution motion blur or chaotic crowd movement where objects remain physically grounded.
blocks.zh: 常识3规则 R1. 报告: 地板上浮出的或破碎的物品,没有明显的下降、碰撞或接触事件。 R2. 报告: 一个人的面部表情或身体姿势在周围环境变化时保持非自然的静态. R3. 忽略:低分辨率运动模糊或混乱的人群运动,物体在其中仍然被实际禁足。
